text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I was able to place<n>reasonably high, but
I'll admit I'm not<n>quite satisfied...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I must accept my limits as of now and<n>use this
result as motivation moving<n>forward.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I set out to give it my all, and I believe<n>I managed to
do just that.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
To fail despite those efforts is an<n>indication that I
am lacking something.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But I will not dwell on this more than<n>necessary.
Instead, I must press<n>forward with my eyes on the
next<n>target.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My goal is the peak that lies at this<n>path's end.
These results merely<n>show that I have yet to arrive
there.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Steadily and calmly, we must build on<n>what we
have achieved. Let us better<n>ourselves race by
race, Trainer.
